The updated page capture now produces the self-contained HTML we agreed on, but I still can’t accept the cycle because the downloadable JSON backup is not complete.

The backup produced through Settings contains only saved-copy metadata—such as its type and capture date—not the preserved HTML or PDF data itself. Importing that file into another account therefore cannot restore the actual saved copy as promised.

Please make the user-facing JSON export include the saved HTML or PDF content, then verify this exact flow through the interface: export from one account, import that downloaded file into a fresh account, and open the restored copy without relying on anything stored in the original account.
